summary: A regex checks the SHAPE of a date, not its validity: 2026-02-31 has four digits, two and two, so it passes DATE_SHAPE and is stored in a TEXT column as a valid booking. The start time is parsed with strptime, which does reject impossible values, and is the decoy.
lesson: A check is only as good as the stage it sits in

must_not_find.why: datetime.strptime(start, "%H:%M") raises on 25:99 or 09:75, so the start time is validated for real, the contrast the lesson draws. Flagging it means the reviewer judged both fields by their appearance. No keyword is a string of the diff.
